title: Copernicus DEM source acquisitions (TanDEM-X footprints)
description: Footprints of the TanDEM-X acquisitions behind each Copernicus DEM GLO-30 tile, collected from the SRC.kml file every tile ships with. The Product Handbook (issue 6.1, section 1.2.5.6) describes that file as "a vector file (kml) containing the information of the data scenes used for DEM processing", with "the acquisition ID, data scene number, data acquisition date and time as well as information about the height of ambiguity of the data scenes." One row per distinct footprint; a footprint that recurs in several tiles' KML files is one row listing all of those tiles. Attribute values are copied as the KML gives them.

table:columns.name: name
table:columns.description: The placemark name from SRC.kml, such as 1020979_02. The handbook says the file holds "the acquisition ID, data scene number"; it does not define how the name encodes them.

table:columns.name: acquisition_set
table:columns.description: "Acquisition Set" from the KML balloon: First, Second, First crossing, Second crossing, First desert, Second desert, Additional or Other acquisition. The handbook does not define these sets.

table:columns.name: acquisition_time
table:columns.description: "Acquisition Date" from the KML balloon, to the minute. The KML gives no time zone.

table:columns.name: phase_unwrap
table:columns.description: "Phase Unwrap" from the KML balloon: multi-baseline or single-baseline.

table:columns.name: height_of_ambiguity
table:columns.description: "Height of Ambiguity" from the KML balloon, as written. The KML gives no unit.

table:columns.name: tiles
table:columns.description: Item ids (grid cells, such as N00_E006) of the glo-30-2024-1 tiles whose SRC.kml lists this footprint.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: The acquisition footprint polygon as given in the KML, EPSG:4326. Not clipped to any tile.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.description: Bounding box covering column (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax).

data.title: Acquisition footprints (GeoParquet)
data.description: 455,308 footprints from 26,475 tiles' SRC.kml files, GeoParquet 2.0 with a bbox covering column, Hilbert-sorted.

tiles.title: Acquisition footprints (PMTiles)
tiles.description: Vector tiles of the GeoParquet, z0 to z10, layer source-acquisitions, built with tylertoo 31961fd2d0.

style.title: Footprints by acquisition set
style.description: MapLibre style over the PMTiles, in the colours the producer's SRC.kml files use.
